A great quick weeknight dinner is **One-Pan Lemon Garlic Chicken with Veggies**:

**Ingredients:** 2 chicken breasts, 1 lb broccoli florets, 1 sliced bell pepper, 3 minced garlic cloves, juice of 1 lemon, 2 tbsp olive oil, dried oregano, salt/pepper.

**Steps:** 1) Pound chicken to even thickness. 2) Toss chicken and veggies on sheet pan with oil, garlic, lemon, oregano, salt/pepper. 3) Roast 20 min at 425°F until chicken hits 165°F. Serve with quick rice or crusty bread.
